title: Durga IPS
desc: Police officer Chennamma takes on the task of eliminating a gangster and his evil son in order to save society from their tyranny.

title: Bol Radha Bol
desc: While Kishen enjoys village life and romance with Radha, a sinister doppelgänger plots. Upon returning home, he'll discover his identity and life stolen by this malevolent impostor.

title: Prem Granth
desc: Somen, a rich man, falls in love with Kajri, a village belle. However, they get separated when she suddenly leaves for unknown reasons.

title: Himmat
desc: Gana, an ex-army officer turned vigilante, is raised by his uncle. Soon, he meets Hansita, who only agrees to marry him if he changes his violent ways.

title: Khal Nayak
desc: Inspector Ram succeeds in nabbing notorious criminal Ballu. When Ballu's escape taints Ram's name, his fiancée, Ganga, decides to trap Ballu. But, things get complicated when Ballu starts liking her.
